_comment: Entra Cloud Sync scope for Halden (P2, lab only). Read by 05-Prepare-HybridIdentity.ps1 and used by the Cloud Sync agent configuration on FS01. Only OU=Users,OU=Halden is in scope. _Admin and ServiceAccounts are excluded so that privileged and service identities never leave the on-premises directory: admin accounts stay cloud-only and service accounts stay on-prem. This is standard Tier 0 hygiene. Paths are relative to the domain DN ad.halden.internal.

syncRules.userPrincipalName: Use the tenant's verified or onmicrosoft.com UPN suffix; never sync the .internal UPN as a routable address.
syncRules.scopedObjects: Users only. Groups and devices are not in scope in this project.
syncRules.softDelete: Cloud deletions are soft-deleted for 30 days.
